featured_reviews.name: Payal Malu
featured_reviews.review_text:
🌸 A Pretty-in-Soft Pink Dessert Haven

If you're looking for a cozy, Instagram-worthy spot with good vibes and even better food, The Sweet Side Cafe in Mira Road East is a must-visit.

🍴 What I Tried:

•	Cold Coffee: Creamy, smooth, and refreshing. It wasn’t overly sweet, which I appreciated—it let the coffee flavor shine. A solid pick-me-up.

•	White Sauce Pasta: Rich and comforting, with a good balance of creaminess and seasoning. The pasta was cooked just right—not too soft, not too firm.

•	Pizza: Thin-crust, generously topped, and served hot. The cheese pull was real! While not wood-fired, it delivered on flavor.

•	Bomboloni: These Italian-style doughnuts were soft, pillowy, and filled with a delightful surprise (I had the chocolate-filled one). A must-try for sweet lovers.

•	Cheesecake: Creamy and indulgent with a buttery base. Classic New York-style feel—lightly tangy and not overly dense. Bonus points for the elegant presentation.

•	Korean Cheese Bun: This was the wildcard of the order. It was soft, slightly sweet, and had that gooey cheese center that made it both a snack and a comfort food. Loved it.

🌸 Ambience at The Sweet Side Cafe
The first thing you'll notice about The Sweet Side Cafe is its charming pink-themed decor—soft, inviting, and picture-perfect. The walls are adorned with subtle floral elements, pastel tones, and cozy lighting that create a calm and cheerful vibe. Whether you're catching up with friends, working on your laptop, or just treating yourself, the space feels warm and welcoming.

The seating is comfortable, with a mix of tables and cozy corners, making it ideal for both quick bites and long conversations. Light music in the background adds to the relaxed atmosphere without overpowering your chats.

It’s clear the café was designed with both comfort and aesthetics in mind—a perfect blend of cute and classy, making it a favorite for both casual hangouts and Instagrammable moments.

💁‍♀️ Service & Pricing:
The staff was friendly and polite, making sure everything arrived fresh and on time. Pricing is reasonable for the variety and portion sizes offered.

✅ Overall Verdict:
The Sweet Side Cafe is more than just a pretty space—it delivers on taste too. Whether you're here for a quick dessert, a hearty meal, or just coffee and conversation, it won’t disappoint. A sweet spot for sweet moments!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you Payal for the detailed, wonderful and valuable review. It is great knowing you as a customer and as a good friend. Keep visiting the Sweet Side cafe for more delicious and tasty food and desserts😇😊

featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely disappointed with my recent experience at Cheat Day Cafe.
I had booked a 1st Anniversary surprise for my husband after seeing their Instagram videos, which showed beautiful décor, unique smoke entry, and a well-managed setup. Unfortunately, the reality was completely different.
• I was charged ₹1000 for 1 hour.
• When my family arrived 15 minutes late, the time was extended by 30 minutes. The extra charge should have been ₹400, but I was asked to pay ₹500 without any clear explanation.
• The food served was cold.
• Only one staff member was available to manage everything.
• The decoration was not changed as requested (I had specifically asked for red balloons for my anniversary). It looked like the previous setup was simply handed over to us.
• The smoke entry was not impressive at all and nothing like what was shown in their Instagram videos.
• No menu card was provided.
• No proper bill was given.
• They did not share pictures of the decoration despite my request.
The entire experience felt misleading and unprofessional. My family was not happy, and what was meant to be a special, memorable evening turned into a very disappointing one.
I would strongly suggest future customers to clarify every detail in writing and confirm charges beforehand. Transparency and proper service are basic expectations, especially when someone is paying for a “surprise celebration” package.
Very disheartened with the overall experience.
